layout_note: Back-matter errata leaf. Single ruled box; heading 'FAVLTS ESCAPED IN THE PRINTING.' at top, italic subtitle, then a densely-set single-column running errata list (entries run continuously, many per line, NOT one-per-line) under two sub-headings 'In the firſt Tome.' and 'IN THE SECOND TOME.', closing with a note 'We haue alſo found ſome other faults...'. Below a horizontal rule sits the French 'Extraict du Privilege du Roy' box — that box is EXCLUDED here (transcribed separately in matter-ot2-privilege-du-roi.json). No printed page number or running header. Ornamental floriated drop-cap initial ('P') opens the first errata entry. Body is roman; subtitle and the head/hand pair are italic; 'Correct' (2nd-tome opener) is bold. Reader/manuscript strikethrough marks cross 'roclaime' and 'thoſe places' on the 2nd-tome opening line.

Printed typo preserved: 'daaknes' (compositor set 'a' for 'r') as the FAULT word for the correction 'darknes'. Both kept as printed (the correction itself is spelled 'darknes').
Within the 'veſſel/veſſels' place-list: an isolated 'p. 25.' sits between two 'p 254' references — anomalous. Possibly 'l. 25.' or a compositor misprint; glyph reads 'p. 25.'

'212' hundreds digit ambiguous (2 vs 4; could be '412'); appears out of ascending sequence after 322. Neighbouring 'p. 252' / 'p. 200' (line 11) are also low-order after 322, so the list is genuinely non-monotonic here — page numerals in this dense block are medium/low confidence.

Page numeral degraded — printed as '4 , 8' / '4 8'; most likely 'p. 408.' Fault 'bewen' -> 'between'.

glyph_regime_resolved: Single roman body fount across the whole errata. w vs vv: the body sets a REAL connected 'w' throughout (way, we, warre, which, with, was, When, wherby, bewen/between) — NO genuine gapped 'vv' present on this leaf; all transcribed 'w'. long-ſ is GLYPH-DRIVEN and mixed: long-ſ in ſides, ſperate/ſeparate, ſoone/ſonne, ſpake/ſpeake, ſhinne, ſo, ſweere/ſweet, wiſe, veſſel/veſſels (ſſ), Caſſiodorus, ſometimes, and closing alſo/ſome/leſſe/truſt/eaſily/beſeech/thoſe/ſhal/ſet; ROUND final s in darknes, tables, prayers, kinreds, veſſels(final), skinne, Iewes, faults. ct ligatures rendered as component 'ct' (correction, Correct). u/v and i/j preserved as printed (vlt, liuer/liued, aboue, geue-type; Iephone, Iewes). French spacing (space before comma/high punctuation) preserved where set: 'returned , turned', 'in fine ,', 'ſhinne , skinne', 'adde , King', 'they , this', 'others :', 'text ,', 'ſweere thy ,'. Italic: subtitle line and the emphasised fault/correction pair 'head, hand' (line 19). Bold: 'Correct' (line 27, 2nd-tome opener).
